form.archiveHint: Archived timeline templates no longer create tasks. Existing tasks stay.

versions.label: Versions

hint.draft: Only the draft can be edited. Publishing does not change existing events.
hint.published: Published versions are immutable. Start a new draft to change something.
hint.retired: This version was replaced by a newer one and is kept for reference.

versions.discardDescription: All changes in the draft are lost. Published versions stay as they are.
versions.publishDescription: The version becomes immutable and applies to events created from now on. Existing events do not change.
versions.retires: The previous version v{version} will be retired.
versions.published: Version {version} published. Existing events are unchanged.

ruler.caption: Timeline (view only): each dot stands for one or more tasks, T is the anchor. Beyond ±30 days the scale is compressed.
ruler.hint: Hover or focus a dot to see which tasks it stands for. A click opens the first one.

grid.title: Tasks
grid.editHint: Click a row to edit · ⋯ for order, duplicate, delete
grid.caption: Tasks of the timeline template: the season first, then every date by phase
grid.count: {count, plural, =0 {no tasks} one {# task} other {# tasks}}

delete.doneChildren: {count, plural, one {“{title}” and its subtask deleted} other {“{title}” and its # subtasks deleted}}

drawer.title: Task
drawer.offsetHint: Negative = before the anchor, positive = after. −30 reads “T-30”, 3 reads “T+3”.
drawer.exampleNone: The example has no date for this anchor.
drawer.roleHint: A role, not a person: at each event whoever holds the role there takes the task.
drawer.permitTypeHint: Closes itself once this permit is applied for or granted for the event. Only for tasks that apply for a permit.
drawer.isKeyHint: Every market needs this task. It shows in the key-task overview and is emphasised more strongly when late.
drawer.conditionHint: Without a selection the task is created for every event.
drawer.conditionVenueIds: {count, plural, one {Also limited to # specific venue.} other {Also limited to # specific venues.}}
drawer.draftHint: Applies to new events once you publish.
drawer.parentHint: Subtasks are created under their parent task at every event and stay in its phase.
drawer.hasChildrenHint: This task has subtasks, so it cannot become a subtask itself (one level only).
drawer.ownDueHint: Unticked, the subtask is due like its parent task and moves along when the parent's due date changes.

children.hint: Subtasks are due like the parent task and go to the same role unless you set something else.
children.saveFirst: Please save or cancel first: the changes to this task would be lost otherwise.
children.newItemHint: You can add subtasks once the task has been added.

drawer.scopeHint: Every date: the task is created for every event of the market. Whole season: it is created once a year for the season and is due from the season start or the season end.
drawer.scopeInherited: Applies to the whole season, like its parent task.
drawer.exampleSeasonEnd: A season without dates has no season end: the task has no due date until then.
drawer.conditionHintSeason: Without a selection the task is created for the season of every market that uses this template.
drawer.roleHintSeason: A role, not a person: for the season whoever holds the role in the market's default team takes the task.
drawer.parentHintSeason: Subtasks are created once per season under their parent task.

links.title: Used by presets
links.hint: New events created from these presets get the tasks of this timeline (from the published version). Existing events do not change.
links.none: There are no event presets yet.
links.master: The master template belongs to no single market: every new market starts with its own copy. Changes here only apply to markets you add afterwards.
links.owned: This is the own task template of {name}. It started as a copy of the master template and changes only here.

rules.title: How it works
rules.published: Published versions are immutable; changes are made in a draft.
rules.newEvents: New events get the tasks of the published version.
rules.apply: Existing events and seasons only change through “Apply to events…”, after a preview and with nothing pre-selected.
rules.followAnchors: When an event moves, open tasks move along; done ones never. Without their own time, tasks are due at {time}.

apply.title: Apply to events
apply.subtitle: {name}, version {version}
apply.intro: Existing events and seasons take over the published version here. Nothing is pre-selected: you decide per event and season. Done tasks and tasks edited by hand stay as they are.
apply.empty: No upcoming event and no open season needs this version.
apply.noChecklist: No timeline from this template yet

summary.cancel: {count, plural, one {# subtask is cancelled} other {# subtasks are cancelled}}

apply.markedRemoved: the task stays open and is marked “No longer in the template”, not deleted
apply.rules: Due dates and assignments set by hand are kept on changed tasks. Subtasks whose row was removed are cancelled. Nothing is deleted.
